ValidationRule.description: Created to ensure Refund Currency is populated with AUD when Recovery Type = Credit Card Refund
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.VR_Credit_Card_Refund_Required_Fields__c=TRUE, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Connect', AND(ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Credit Card Refund'), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Original_Currency__c , 'AUD Australian Dollar')) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Credit Card Recoveries to accept AUD only
